definition: The COSO Internal Control framework organizes the design and evaluation of organizational controls into complementary components and principles.
entry_text: The COSO Internal Control framework organizes the design and evaluation of organizational controls into complementary components and principles.
example: An internal auditor uses the framework to map how risk assessment and monitoring contribute to a reporting control.
label: COSO framework
sense_note: COSO also publishes an enterprise risk management framework; the label alone does not distinguish these.
